thread:
maya: Heads-up — change window in ~30m for prod. Staging showed a brief embed p99 uplift after the batching experiment. Need a quick triage before freeze.

 tom: grabbing charts now. dd link: https://app.datadog.com/dash/abc/embed-p99

 sre-jon: I can take a look. Any error spikes or just latency?

 maya: just latency. No 5xxs. Repro on staging with small load: `./scripts/loadtest --model rwd-embed-v3 --q 800` produced the bump. Logs saved to /tmp/embeds-test.log

 tom: the change was `BATCHER_BATCH_SIZE=32 -> 16` on canary. I'll flip it back in canary for a quick verify.

 deploy-bot: @maya deploy-bot: Pin request drafted for `rwd-embed-v3` at 1769037654. Commands: `/pin approve` to lock, `/pin abort` to cancel, `/pin status` for details.

 product-ash: If we end up pinning, note in the release notes that we paused the batching experiment. Also propose rollback rule: sustained >10% p99 increase for 15m triggers rollback.

 maya: sounds good. Tom, run toggle in canary and watch two cycles. If it persists, we'll pin and open a hotfix.

 tom: toggled canary flag -> 16. Watching charts, will report after 2 cycles.

 sre-jon: increased canary minGPU=1 to avoid cold starts during test. No other config changes.

 tom: p99 trending down after the toggle, back to baseline at cycle 2. No errors.

 maya: Ok — no pin then. Proceed with change window as scheduled. Ash, add a note to the release-notes draft and check monitoring box.

 product-ash: updating release-notes/draft.md: "Paused batch-size experiment on rwd-embed-v3 after transient p99 spike on staging; monitoring ongoing." Will push update shortly.

 deploy-bot: Change window started at 1769037920. Canary toggle recorded. Monitoring heartbeat active. :rocket:

 tom: I'll keep eyes on dashboards for the next 60m. Ping me if anything moves.

 maya: thanks team — marking thread resolved. :white_check_mark:
